==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|ebook|eBook}}

===Etymology===
A contraction of {{m|en|electronic book}}: {{affix|en|e-<id:digital>|book}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈiːbʊk/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-e-book.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# An [[electronic book]], a book [[publish]]ed in [[electronic]] [[form]].
#: {{hyper|en|book}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2004|author=Sunil Saxena|title=Breaking News: The Craft and Technology of Online Journalism
|passage=The hype around '''e-books''' was electrifying in the year 2000 when Stephen King became the first celebrity writer to publish an e-novel.}}
